title: The inner citadel
src: Marcus Aurelius, Meditations 8.48; Pierre Hadot, The Inner Citadel
idea: Marcus Aurelius pictured the calm mind as a fortress. Others can shout, but they cannot reach your judgments unless you let them.
apply: When someone provokes you, pause and retreat to what you control: your judgment and your next action. Answer from there.
remind: Retreat inward. Answer from your own ground.
who: Zara, a nurse facing an angry family member after a hard shift.

msgs.x: This is unacceptable! Nobody tells us anything!
I have worked twelve hours straight.

scenes.cap: End of a twelve hour shift
scenes.nar: Zara is finishing a twelve hour shift when a family member starts shouting at her. Nobody has told them anything, they say.
Her first instinct is to snap back, take it personally, and carry it home. The shouting has taken over her mood.
Marcus Aurelius pictured the calm mind as a fortress. Zara retreats inside. The shouting is outside, and her judgment, her next step, and her tone are hers.
She breathes once, lowers her voice, and explains what she can share. The family member calms, and Zara goes home without carrying it.
